title: Forest of Piano
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kai Ichinose, the son of a prostitute in a red-light district, secretly plays an abandoned piano in the forest that no one else can sound. Transfer student Shuhei, son of a professional pianist, and their music teacher Ajino, a former master whose career and fiancee were lost in an accident, recognize his gift. Kai reluctantly takes lessons, and over 26 volumes the friends and rivals grow toward the International Chopin Piano Competition.
life_message: Talent and love of music can lift a child beyond the circumstances of his birth, and true artistry comes from one's own sound.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Classical tradition in a modern secular setting.
